             So, let's talk about the earnings-sharing
mechanism. Under our stipulation, each year, beginning
with results from calendar year 2027, the company will
file an earnings report in the same format as its
surveillance reports. And Staff and Public Counsel may
review it and take discovery.

case by more than 20 basis points, then 65 percent of the

liability and return through rates at a later rate case.

for the benefit of low-income customers.

sharing would occur. And each of these conditions was
included in the Ameren Missouri stipulation, which Staff
